snippet.title: Failed Falling - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Failed Falling is a challenging platformer where falling is not a threat, but the goal. Taking place on an active volcano, sail its updrafts by using an automatic parachute, while not getting trapped on them and losing progress.
Featuring an innovative temporary checkpoint system, it aims at being both beginner friendly and difficult to master.

Download the demo on Steam, leave a review and wishlist the game:
steampowered.com/app/3621600
